faq_heading: Homes near Guildford Park Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Guildford Park Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Guildford Park Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Guildford Park Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Guildford Park Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 375 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,100,000, townhomes $610,000, condos $423,750. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Guildford Park Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Guildford Park Secondary the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 96.2% of the list price, with 6% of sales above the list price for the 375 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Guildford Park Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (0.4 km west), Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.6 km north-east) and Hjorth Road Elementary (0.7 km south-east).

How the Guildford Park Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Guildford Park Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Guildford Park Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 375 homes sold within 2 km of Guildford Park Secondary: 89 houses, 78 townhomes and 208 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $423,750.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Guildford Park Secondary

24 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Guildford Park Secondary in a straight line (20 elementary, 4 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Mary Jane Shannon Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Theresa Clarke Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (1.8 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Riverdale Elementary (0.6 km). Other secondary schools close by: Honour Secondary School (1.8 km west), Johnston Heights Secondary (2.2 km south-east), Kwantlen Park Secondary (2.9 km west), Fraser Heights Secondary (3.0 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Johnston Heights Secondary, 2.2 km south-east of Guildford Park Secondary.
